newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ABS-CBN mulls spin-off of news unit.
newsitem.headline: ABS-CBN mulls spin-off of news unit.

text.p: ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp, the Philippines' largest broadcasting company, said on Tuesday it is looking at spinning off its news department into a separate unit.

"That (the study) has been in the works for quite some time. We want to become like CNN or other foreign broadcast entities who not only handle news but are also able to sell them," ABS-CBN corporate affairs director Butch Raquel told Reuters.
Once the spin-off takes place, Raquel said ABS-CBN would probably become a holding company.
Company sources said shares of the news company might be sold off to the public, but Raquel said the possibility of an initial public offering was not covered by the study.
He could not say when the study would be completed.
ABS-CBN was formerly a unit of Benpres Holdings Corp.
Recently shareholders approved the transfer of the Benpres stake in ABS-CBN to the unlisted Lopez Inc.
The move was made to allow foreigners to buy Benpres shares, previously barred because of the restriction on non-Filipinos buying into local media companies.
ABS-CBN earlier said it expects to post 1.8 billion pesos in net profit this year from 1.53 billion in 1996.
